schema.name: nx_sim_heat_power
schema.description: Assign total internal heat in finite nonnegative watts to one prototype FEM body ID from nx_sim_faces. Requires an active NX MULTIPHYSICS Thermal SIM with one direct FEM occurrence. Returns a typed simulation_load reference and committed SIM body/power readback. Rejects an existing heat load on that body and duplicate names. Nonempty provenance is stored on the native load. Only internal heat belongs here: do not add exported electrical energy or battery storage, or sum converter input and output as heat. Visible undo/rollback; does not save or solve. Coupled-flow, time-dependent and multi-body power assignment are not exposed here. Supply operation_id for safe retry.

outputSchema.description: Structured success/error envelope with additive metadata. Tool-specific payload remains extensible.
